title: Q2 Priority Slices for Hosted API + Model Catalog (Market-driven)
creator: Sofia Reyes
description: Purpose: Define a market-driven set of priority 'slices' (feature bundles + model lineup changes) for Q2 that map hosted API product investments to demand cohorts and capacity constraints. This ticket scopes the delivery plan that balances: (1) low-latency tier (SLA 50ms P50) enhancements, (2) model-catalog curation/rotation windows, and (3) cost-optimization experiments (quantization + batching defaults) for high-volume customers. Outcome: a signed-off, time-boxed roadmap slice map that PM, Eng, and Design can operationalize in the next two cycles.
milestones: 2026-03-01: Draft slice map and initial OKR mapping complete
2026-03-19: Canary scheduling and gating criteria defined; dependencies assigned
2026-03-26: Finalize implementation plan and handoff to Eng squads
2026-04-10: Pre-release readiness check and stakeholder sign-off
acceptance_criteria: A1: Priority slices documented with clear owner, success metrics, and rollout cadence
A2: For each slice, a canary plan exists with rollback criteria and metrics dashboard widgets
A3: Eng dependencies (kernel selection, autoscaling knobs) are scoped with estimates and risks
A4: Design has approved UX copy and console flows for per-route cost/latency visibility
A5: Exec summary and OKR mapping approved by Head of Product
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Model rotation causes regressions for specific customer cohorts. Mitigation: require eval set pass rate >= 98% on cohort signal before promotion; add fallback to previous model variant.
Risk: Dedicated capacity constraints during seasonal spikes. Mitigation: reserve burst pools for top 10% customers and introduce soft-throttles for non-SLA tiers.
Risk: Canaries not providing enough traffic diversity. Mitigation: synthetic traffic generator + sampled real traffic to canary buckets for first 48 hours.
